name: Video Station
description: Browse and watch the videos on your NAS: a cinema library with poster shelves, Continue Watching, Movies/Series, search and My List; HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV on desktop and phones; resume, subtitles, keyless metadata (Cinemeta/TVmaze) with optional TMDB, and a media-engine panel (VA-API/QuickSync/software). The video API stays in EthOS so the Android Video app keeps working.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.1.0: metadata works without an API key — Cinemeta (movies and series, posters/backdrops/rating/cast) plus TVmaze (official series fallback), with an optional TMDB key for Polish titles and overviews. New provider picker, per-source health check, missing/re-fetch-all actions, source attribution and automatic bounded metadata fetch. Requires EthOS 2.13.0. 2.0.0: new cinema UI (full-bleed top nav, backdrop hero, poster shelves, detail pages, bottom tab bar on phones), server-side HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV with VA-API/QuickSync hardware decode and encode, a real media-engine panel with probe diagnostics, working quality/audio/subtitle pickers, server-side My List, responsive touch layout and lazy poster loading. Requires EthOS 2.12.0. 1.0.2: renamed to Videos as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: light theme for the shell, rows and empty states (the hero and player stay cinematic), and adding a folder uses the EthOS folder picker. 1.0.0: first release.
